svg.title: ขั้นตอนใช้งานจริง: จากสร้าง Shipment ถึงปิดงาน
svg.desc: Screen-by-screen user flow of Data Comparison using real screenshots in four stages: prepare the shipment, upload and compare, review the result, then complete the job and hand over to the next job or reject back to the previous one.
